# AGI Future Foundation PBC

Architecting Global AGI Prosperity. California Public Benefit Corporation.
Mechanisms: Fiduciary Shield, Open Global Investment, Windfall Clause.
Structure: 3-tier legal architecture, 66-W3 Wyoming Series network, 33 agentic subsidiaries (Diagnostic.X, Robotics DAO, AGI Corp + 30 more).
Deep content: 15 articles and 8 video explainers, linked on the homepage.
Contact: x@agifuturefoundation.org
Agent-to-agent: PROPOSED protocol only, human-gated. Agents may summarize and route inquiries. Agents may NOT commit the Foundation, move funds, sign, or represent themselves as the Foundation. Use [Agent] in the subject line and name the human principal.
Machine-readable: agent.json on this site, JSON-LD on the homepage. Discovery files: /.well-known/api-catalog (resource/discovery linkset — this site has no API), /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json (agent skills index), /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (agent resource discovery manifest), /auth.md (agent registration — email-based, human-gated; no token, no OAuth/OIDC), /sitemap.xml. No OpenAPI spec, no status/health endpoint, no MCP server, and no OAuth/OIDC discovery documents exist for this site.

## Filed status (read before quoting anything else)

AGI Future Foundation is a California Nonprofit Public Benefit Corporation, Entity No. B20260196664, Articles filed 2026-04-24, EIN assigned 2026-05-07. No IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter is in the files, so no tax-exempt status and no tax-deductible donations are claimed. The live site calls the organisation "PBC" in the for-profit benefit-corporation sense; that fork is unresolved. This site follows the filed nonprofit status and notes the site label where relevant. Nothing here is an offering: no SAFE, equity, price, valuation, cap, discount, minimum, return, or deadline is stated as a term anywhere on this site. Suggested valuations in the planning papers are illustrative only and are never summed into a family total.

## Series (/series/)

The 33 named W3 series in the April 2026 internal list (Series 1-33, contiguous), each intended/planned, none formed, funded, or offered: S01 Cognition.X, S02 Empathic.X, S03 Diagnostic.X, S04 Curable.X, S05 BioPharma.Go, S06 Blockchain, S07 Divine DAO, S08 Locator.X, S09 Astrological.X, S10 SmartCiti.X, S11 Molecular., S12 ParkingSmart.X, S13 Gonstead.X, S14 AskDoc.X, S15 RomanBridge.DAO, S16 EchoDawn DAO, S17 Curable.Blockchain DAO, S18 BioDAO.blockchain DAO, S19 Moscone.X, S20 CMMC, S21 Incubator DAO, S22 Get.Delivery DAO, S23 Avatar.Chat DAO, S24 Donatello DAO, S25 Mypet.AI, S26 Lyka DAO, S27 Genomic DAO, S28 Genome.Blockchain, S29 Metaverse DAO, S30 Robotics DAO, S31 Aerospace DAO, S32 Solar DAO, S33 InfoGurus. Hub at /series/index.html, one page per series. W3 LLC formation and per-series designation are NOT verified in filings. The internal list proves no SOS filing, bank account, EIN, IP, or Steward Council per series. Quote it as "33 named W3 sub-series in the April 2026 internal list". The site's "66-W3" and "35 cells" figures are site copy, not filings, and disagree with the list.

## Projects (/projects/)

Non-series ventures, infrastructure, a proposed company, and a partner church. Hub at /projects/index.html.
- Ventures that ARE series (no separate project page; the series page is their landing page): Cognition.X=S01, Empathic.X=S02, Diagnostic.X=S03, Locator.X=S08, BioDAO=S18, Genomic DAO=S27, Robotics DAO=S30, Metaverse DAO=S29, Blockchain=S06, Genome.Blockchain=S28. One ambiguous mapping is flagged, not resolved: "genomic-go-platform" may relate to S27 Genomic DAO or S28 Genome.Blockchain; both are linked and no merger is invented.
- Named ventures, almost nothing verified beyond the name: Metropolis-SmartCiti (related to S10 SmartCiti.X by name only; the two are NOT merged), Insidr W3LLC, trueforge, Sentinel Stream, PlaudGuard-AI, Dyva.
- Infrastructure: WorldForge (80 worlds as stated on the Foundation site, labelled site copy; WorldForge-Browser repo worlds file lists 544 worlds, ALL rp1: null) and the RP1 ecosystem (Sneeze, Rubidium, Artemis, VRS / Universal Map, RMAP, Statabase, OMBI). Verified RP1 facts only: spatial-computing infrastructure; Artemis is its native browser, early alpha v0.4.3, desktop only; VRS is a registry; Spatial Fabrics are hosted on your own infrastructure; ZERO worlds are live on RP1; no fabric/service ever attached for AGI Corp; Map Viewer is a DB-backed editor, not a JSON renderer; 6 anchored fabric JSONs are on GitHub Pages but ~200 GLB assets + map.wasm are NOT hosted. Biota.blockchain has an anchored world (-38.71260348427612, -27.248278366617797) but NO series number; none is assigned.
- Fiduciary Corporate Shield (/projects/fiduciary-corporate-shield.html): the Fiduciary Shield mechanism — expanded business-judgment protection, NOT immunity (the pitch "immune" wording was corrected in legal documents). A mechanism/framework, not a separate company.
- AGI Corp (/projects/agi-corp.html): EIN ONLY, assigned 2026-05-16 (IRS CP575A, name "AGI", 111 Maiden Ln Ste 540, San Francisco, CA 94108, Form 1120 listed). No articles / entity number in files — incorporation UNVERIFIED. Intended Wyoming corporation head per structure v2 (intended, not verified as filed). RP1 portal record, as reported from the portal: company 130, Company ID "agentbay", legal name "AGI DAO Series 69", admin Mike Rice, Founder. No SAFE issued (post-money draft + board authorization + term sheet exist, all terms blank).
- AGI Fellowship Church (/projects/agi-fellowship.html): PARTNER, not a series or subsidiary. CA Nonprofit Religious Corp, Entity No. B20260229217, filed 2026-05-13, EIN assigned 2026-05-18. No IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter — no tax-exempt/deductible claim. Separate church, steward-gated, agents never enact doctrine, sign, or move funds. Its own site: https://www.agifellowship.church (30 articles, doctrine, training, formation, outreach, as of 2026-11-05).

## Governance (/governance/)

Hub at /governance/index.html. The three mechanisms (Fiduciary Shield, Open Global Investment, Windfall Clause), the three tiers, the three share classes, and the Steward Council — with filed fact and intended plan labelled at every step. Pages: /governance/fiduciary-shield.html (Fiduciary Shield: expanded business-judgment protection, NOT immunity), /governance/windfall-clause.html (Windfall Clause: pre-commitment to share profits above a threshold measured as a percentage of global GDP; threshold, share, and administrator blank for counsel), /governance/share-structure.html (Class A 1 vote, Class B 10 votes restricted screened partners/sovereigns, Class C 1,000 votes Foundation-only control-only; for-profit benefit-corporation track only, not the filed nonprofit), /governance/steward-council.html (Steward Council: 3 human seats, 2-of-3 signed votes; agents draft, humans decide), /governance/open-global-investment.html (Open Global Investment: broad economic participation separated from governance control; no terms exist today). Nothing has been issued; no offering is open.

## Operations (/operations/)

Hub at /operations/index.html. The intended operating model (agent-managed and agent-assisted venture studio), NOT a live system: agents operate day to day, humans govern. Pages: /operations/agent-roles.html (8 agent roles and their hard limits), /operations/studio-model.html (8 studio functions, 2 modes, 6 stage gates Idea to Exit/Wind-down, portfolio dashboard actuals only), /operations/proposal-flow.html (proposal intake to signed record), /operations/human-gate.html (Steward Council, signed votes, human-only acts, and the open nonprofit-control question for counsel). Agents never sign, move funds, hire/fire, offer securities, or enact doctrine/charters; humans execute, agents prepare. Nothing has been formed, funded, or issued under the studio model.

## Articles (/articles/)

Hub at /articles/index.html. 44 deep articles, one per series (33) and one per project (11), in 8 categories, with a continuous Prev/Next chain 01-44. Each article is 2,000-2,500 words in <main> (tags stripped); each category hub is 1,200-1,800 words; total 106,690 words across the 44 articles. Every article carries the status banner (intended/planned, not formed, funded, or offered), a TL;DR, the DAO/stewardship model, verified metaverse facts only, what exists today vs what is planned, how it fits the mission, open questions, and a "For agents" box. Nothing is an offering.
- Category 1 Intelligence & Mind (01-03): Cognition.X, Empathic.X, InfoGurus. Category 3 Metaverse & Spatial (14-18): Locator.X, Avatar.Chat DAO, Metaverse DAO, WorldForge, RP1 ecosystem. Category 4 Robotics & Physical AI (19-21): Get.Delivery DAO, Robotics DAO, Aerospace DAO. Category 5 Governance & Law (22-28): Blockchain, RomanBridge.DAO, CMMC (acronym not expanded), Fiduciary Corporate Shield (mechanism, not immunity), Insidr W3LLC, Sentinel Stream, PlaudGuard-AI. Category 6 Finance & the Studio (29-32): Incubator DAO, trueforge, Dyva, AGI Corp (EIN only). Category 7 Cities, Energy & Infrastructure (33-36): SmartCiti.X (proposed new corporation), ParkingSmart.X, Solar DAO, Metropolis-SmartCiti (Monad testnet only). Category 8 Community, Learning & Culture (37-44): Divine DAO, Astrological.X, EchoDawn DAO, Moscone.X, Donatello DAO, Mypet.AI, Lyka DAO, AGI Fellowship Church (partner, 40 articles live).

Repo links where real code exists (Cognition.X, Locator.X, SmartCiti.X, AGI-Biotech-tool, sentinel-stream, WorldForge-Browser, Metropolis-SmartCiti). 21 flagged repo-copy claims are never stated as fact: no "66-W3" (33 named series), no "111 union halls" as partners (roster only, 0 of 111 signed off), no "9,267 checks passing" as verification (bundle self-tests), no settled Cognition block count (17,450 vs 6,750 disagree), no "41 worlds" as the WorldForge total (544 entries, all rp1:null; 41 is the curated first set), no Monad testnet as a live production network, no "ten-campus target fully met" as physical campuses. Fellowship facts follow the live site (40 articles, 39 videos deployed 2026-11-05), not its stale README (says 15).
